profile_text.body:
WeRide Inc. is a commercial-stage company that develops autonomous driving technologies spanning Level 2 to Level 4, according to its own website. It describes itself as a global company working to transform urban living with autonomous driving, and says its business footprint covers more than 60 cities across 13 countries. Its headquarters are in Guangzhou, and it is a public company.

The company points to the WeRide One universal autonomous driving technology platform, a self-developed foundational toolchain, and what it describes as an industry-leading accumulation of real-world operational data. It says it offers a portfolio of five core products, including Robotaxi, and describes itself as a pioneer in the large-scale commercial deployment of autonomous driving. It also states that it has been recognized on Fortune's 2026 Change the World and 2025 Future 50 lists.

WeRide is listed on Nasdaq under the ticker WRD and on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under 0800, and its SEC filing identifier is 0001867729. The company is also recorded under the alias WERIDE INC-ADR. No litigation or MCP server records are held for it.
